    Good to know

    What is a ZTL?

    A zona a traffico limitato is a limited traffic zone, usually an old town. Cameras at every entry read the plate of each car. If you don't have a permit while the gates are on, a fine is sent to the car's owner, which for a rental car means you, plus the rental company's fee.

    How do I know if a gate is on?

    Each entry has a sign and usually a light panel that reads 'Varco attivo' (gate on) or 'Varco non attivo' (gate off). GateLR tells you in advance from the city's official hours, but the panel at the gate always wins.

    My hotel is inside the ZTL. What do I do?

    Write to the hotel before you arrive and ask them to register your plate with the city. Many hotels can do this for the day you arrive and leave. Use the message above: it's ready in English, Italian and German.

    I drove in by mistake. What now?

    Note the time and the gate. If your hotel is inside the zone, tell them at once: some cities accept a registration after the fact, within a short time. Otherwise the fine arrives by post; paying within 5 days of notification saves 30%.

    Where do the rules come from?

    From each city's official pages, ordinances and open data, with the link and the date we read them. They are drafts: checked against the official sources but not yet reviewed on site by a person. The sign and the light panel at the gate always win.

    Can I download the app?

    Not yet: GateLR for iPhone is in testing and not yet on the App Store. Until then, this page gives you the same answer for every city, for now or for your arrival time.

    In the iPhone app

    Everything you need before the gate

    The app gives the same answers as this page, for 40 Italian cities, and helps you on the road.

    «Can I enter?»

    One clear answer for where you're going, with the city's official source and the date we read it.

    • ✓You can enter
    • !You can enter if…
    • ✕You can't enter
    • ?To be checked

    Your time, your car

    Tap «Now ▾» to pick tonight, tomorrow or any day and time, and choose the car you're driving: every answer, the map and your trip change together.

    The map

    ZTL zones coloured by the answer, camera gates and pedestrian areas, for the time and car you picked.

    Park outside and walk

    Destination in an active ZTL? Car parks outside it, the minutes on foot, prices and opening hours when known. Works offline.

    Hotel inside the ZTL

    A ready message asking your hotel to register your plate with the city for every day of your stay.

    Guardian

    Drive with Google Maps, Waze or Apple Maps: GateLR stays in the background, warns you before an active ZTL and shows it in the Dynamic Island, a Live Activity and the lock-screen widget.

    GateLR's own navigator

    Turn-by-turn voice directions on a smooth map, rerouting after a wrong turn and a warning before every active gate.

    Siri and Shortcuts

    «Can I enter Florence Sector A with GateLR?», the ZTL nearest to you, or stop the guardian, without opening the app.

    Read the sign

    Point the camera at the ZTL sign: GateLR reads the days and hours and explains them in your language.

    Garage

    «Photograph the registration document» reads fuel and Euro class from EU registration certificates; for a rental car, pick the model from a list.

    «Got a fine?»

    Photograph the notice: was the gate active according to our data, your deadlines, and a draft appeal to complete. General information, not legal advice.
